The '''Lianna system''' was a seven-[[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Star system/Legends|system]] in the [[Allied Tion sector/Legends|Allied Tion sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], one of which was the planet of [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]].
